content.short: RockStarLand is a cross-chain metaverse platform, built for musicians in Unity3D.
content.description: SLUG Token is the in game currency for rockstar.land , a virtual world focused on promoting artists. It’s a 3D video game where players can be landowners. On their land, artists can share their music. Owning an NFT Land tile will allow users to present their content on a musical stage. Additionally, this collective owns land inside of established metaverse platforms, to be used as advertising portals. 5000 RockStarLand Stages have been minted for use.
